title: CppCon 2017: Chandler Carruth “Going Nowhere Faster”
summary: Chandler Carruth shows how to squeeze more performance out of already-optimized C++ code, covering how the CPU executes it. The talk goes into pipelining, branch prediction and speculative execution using benchmarks.
why: Recommended as the best presentation on how modern CPUs run code, and why speculative execution matters for performance.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: The best presentation I've seen about CPU performance related to pipelining, branch prediction, and speculative execution
